reports.category: Report Miscellaneous Crypto Scams with Chainabuse: fake online marketplace
reports.description: I was persuaded by someone I only knew on telegram to become a merchant for an online Chinese marketplace. It seemed too good to be true so I approached with caution. My initial deposit to fund orders was $1000 worth of bitcoin. After about a week I had begun receiving payments for my first orders and was able to successfully make a $50 withdrawal as a test. This put me a little more at ease so I made a larger deposit and a couple weeks later I successfully withdrew $2,000. Soon after I woke up one morning to more than $30,000 in orders that came in overnight. I only had $12,000 in my store account so I reached out to the platform and was told that I had to fund the orders and I would not be allowed to make another withdrawal until I did. Over the next couple week I made several deposits using to cover the cost but as soon as they had all the money they told me that I had broken a fabricated rule and I would have to deposit another $15,000 in order to be able to withdrawal my funds. That was 3 months ago and as of 3 days ago they were still trying to extort me for another $15k. I told them I was going to report them to the authorities and now I am “banned” and cannot even login to the website.

reports.description: I was persuaded by someone I only knew on telegram to become a merchant for an online Chinese marketplace. It seemed too good to be true so I approached with caution. My initial deposit to fund orders was $1000 worth of bitcoin. After about a week I had begun receiving payments for my first orders and was able to successfully make a $50 withdrawal as a test. This put me a little more at ease so I made a larger deposit and a couple weeks later I successfully withdrew $2,000. Soon after I woke up one morning to more than $30,000 in orders that came in overnight. I only had $12,000 in my store account so I reached out to the platform and was told that I had to fund the orders and I would not be allowed to make another withdrawal until I did. Over the next couple week I made several deposits using to cover the cost but as soon as they had all the money they told me that I had broken a fabricated rule and I would have to deposit another $15,000 in order to be able to withdrawal my funds. That was 3 months ago and as of 3 days ago they were still trying to extort me for another $15k. I told them I was going to report them to the authorities and now I am “banned” and cannot even login to the website.
